notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
Queries a specific DNS record type (A, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, SOA, SRV, PTR, AAAA) for a domain. Each type reveals different infrastructure intelligence — don't rely on ANY query (frequently ignored per RFC 8482), query each type explicitly.

=== RECORD INTEL ===
A/AAAA: live host IPs. MX: mail servers (often less hardened, separately administered). NS: authoritative servers (AXFR targets). TXT: SPF internal IPs, SaaS verification tokens (full platform stack). SOA: admin email + primary NS. SRV: internal services with ports. CNAME: aliasing (may point to abandoned third-party infrastructure).

=== TXT RECORD VALUE ===
SPF records expose internal IP ranges in their syntax. Verification tokens (Atlassian, Google, LogMeIn, Mailgun) fingerprint the entire SaaS stack — each platform is its own attack surface.
